correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all even and odd deck transforms of a(x,y)=(x+L,y), b(x,y)=(-x,y+H): twice the injectivity radius is min(L,2H,sqrt(H^2+dist(2x,LZ)^2)). Uniform x gives delta/H uniform on [0,q/2], hence M(q)=q^(-3/2) int_0^(q/2) min(q,2,sqrt(1+u^2)) du. Four integral branches cover every q>0; on (1,2/sqrt3) derivative has sign of Psi(q)=q^2-q sqrt(q^2-1)-3 arcosh(q), strictly decreasing from 1 through zero; other branches strictly decrease. Independent high-precision root/integral checks gave q*=1.03526637121326352489, M*=0.50278123528050473982 and M(1)=0.5, agreeing with package. No nonflat shapes are covered; numbers are corroboration, derivative proof supplies global uniqueness.
